prompt: A perfect dark circle viewed from above. Around the circumference, twenty-three small luminous spheres, each a subtly distinct color, evenly spaced — sparse and isolated. From each sphere, a thin translucent ribbon of light curves inward toward the center. Near the rim the ribbons are separate and delicate. As they approach the center they multiply and layer, converging into a dense radiant knot of merged color — an inevitable collision. Dark background. No text, no numbers, no labels, no people, no faces, no candles.
visual_logic: Twenty-three orbs rim a dark circle, each casting a ribbon inward. Ribbons are sparse at the edge but form an inevitable dense collision at center — mirroring how few nodes generate overwhelming pair-density.
